description: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which the model attends to each input segment—context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts)—during generation, with the vertical axis displaying two categorical labels, 'Ours' and 'Standard,' and the horizontal axis representing percentage composition on a linear scale from 0% to 100%. The 'Ours' bar, segmented into blue (Context, 60.6%), orange (Generated Response, 31.7%), and green (Other, 7.7%), shows a clear dominance of attention to context. The 'Standard' bar, segmented into blue (Context, 23.6%), orange (Generated Response, 51.1%), and green (Other, 25.3%), demonstrates a substantially lower allocation to context and a higher allocation to generated response and other segments compared to 'Ours.' The bars are arranged vertically with 'Ours' positioned above 'Standard,' and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any bar segments; the chart uses a stacked bar format where each bar’s total length represents 100% and is divided proportionally by color-coded segments corresponding to the legend.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation. The vertical axis contains the categories labeled 'Ours' and 'Standard,' while the horizontal axis represents the percentage composition. Each bar is divided into three segments, with colors representing different categories: blue for 'Context,' orange for 'Generated Response,' and green for 'Other.' The 'Ours' bar is composed of approximately 60.6% Context (blue), 31.7% Generated Response (orange), and 7.7% Other (green). The 'Standard' bar consists of approximately 23.6% Context (blue), 41.1% Generated Response (orange), and 35.3% Other (green). Notably, the 'Standard' model demonstrates a significant decline in attention to Context compared to the 'Ours' model, while the attention to Other increases substantially. This suggests that the 'Standard' model prioritizes system prompts over contextual information during generation.
